input.manifest_yaml:
"service": "vault-app"
"components":
  - "id": "uploads"
    "type": "platform"
    "platform": "aws-cloudfront"
    "config":
      "minimumProtocolVersion": "TLSv1.2_2021"
      "aliases":
        - "static-site-cdn-waf.example.com"
      "certificateDomain": "static-site-cdn-waf.example.com"
  - "id": "jobs"
    "type": "platform"
    "platform": "aws-ecr"
    "config":
      "imageTagMutability": "IMMUTABLE"
      "scanOnPush": true
  - "id": "reports"
    "type": "platform"
    "platform": "aws-s3"
    "config":
      "versioning": true
  - "id": "webhook"
    "type": "platform"
    "platform": "aws-cloudtrail"
    "config":
      "isMultiRegionTrail": true
      "enableLogFileValidation": true
      "includeGlobalServiceEvents": true
      "cloudWatchLogsEnabled": true
      "logRetentionDays": 90
"bindings": []
"policyPack": "Baseline"
